notes.title: [NEWS] Time to Collect: Community Items Are On Their Way!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Are you ready for something new and exciting?

We’re thrilled to share that fresh community items are on their way! 🎉 Even better, they’ll be available later this month, so mark your calendars and get ready to enhance your profile in style.

Here’s a special sneak peek at what’s coming your way:

[h3][Badge][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/ff7f225dc7758edecfb80cef81e0d847a9f0aed6.png[/img]

[h3][Trading Card][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/e5f1af50e60f32756dc9493b550c4692c11f288d.png[/img]

[h3][Profile Background][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728753/d4cb6e57d21efceddbb3efa23fab7c22fbe0c520.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! [u][b]We’re also launching an animated avatar[/b][/u] to bring even more life and movement to your community presence.



Stay tuned—you won’t want to miss it! 🌟What
